{{Quote|Ennix Devian?! Palpatine's henchman? I knew him. It sickens me to even hear his name.|Ragez D'Asta, to Kir Kanos|<ref name="ce3.5">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 5|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 5]]</ref>}}
'''Ennix Devian''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who proclaimed himself as the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Restored Empire]], a splinter faction of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]]. Devian served the Empire during the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] personal [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], being trained by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] himself. However the Galactic Empire would fall, and Devian intended to restore it by destroying the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], who were currently losing its conflict with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and took over the Kaarenth Dissension as the Restored Empire and amassed a military comprised of renegade [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], including the forces of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bernard Vota|Vota]], along with discarded hardware of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that was discovered on the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[RZ7-6113-23]], where Devian made his [[RZ7-6113-23 base|base]]. Devian planned to bring about the destruction of both the Imperial Remnant and the New Republic with the use of the volatile substance [[zinethium]], plotting a large scale [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] attack on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to coerce the two sides into obliterating each other.

In order to plant the zinethium on Coruscant, Devian offered the former [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]], [[Kir Kanos]], the chance to join the Restored Empire. Kanos's conflicting sense of honor, which was a foil to Devian's often extreme tactics, prevented him from taking up his invitation. Devian foresaw this and allowed Kanos to escape; knowing he would go to the galactic capital to warn the New Republic, Devian planted the zinethium in the [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|shuttle]] Kanos stole beforehand. The attack failed with the intervention of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] of the [[New Jedi Order]], and [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|Republic forces]] discovered Devian's base on RZ7-6113-23. Abandoning the planetoid, Devian was forced into accelerating his plan by sabotaging peace talks between the New Republic and the Imperial Remnant, which resulted in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Feena D'Asta]], the daughter of the wealthy Imperial affiliated [[Baron/Legends|Baron]], [[Ragez D'Asta]]. Framing the attack on the New Republic, Devian launched a [[Battle of Orinda (13 ABY)|massive attack]] on the Imperial capital [[Orinda/Legends|Orinda]], which was left undefended in the wake of a retaliatory strike against the Republic on Coruscant. When the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial fleet]] commanded by Gilad Pellaeon regrouped at Orinda, Devian captured the [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] and attempted to force him into a surrender. However, Devian's plan collapsed when the [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] of the [[D'Asta family]] arrived to reinforce their Imperial allies; the Baron was enlightened to Devian's involvement in his daughter's murder by Kir Kanos. In the resulting chaos, Devian fought Kir Kanos in one-on-one combat and fell to the Royal Guardsman's [[Double vibroblade|blade]].

==Biography==
===Youth===
Ennix Devian, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], grew up in the aliens slums of [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]] before the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He joined the [[Commission for the Protection of the Republic/Legends|Commission for the Protection of the Republic]] and acquired a reputation for harassing his less dedicated peers. When the Galactic Empire replaced the Republic and COMPOR  became the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] (COMPNOR), Devian transferred into the organization's militarized branch, the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. Devian's brutal ferreting out of any deficiency of nationalism disgusted party founder [[Ardus Kaine]], beginning a lifelong feud. Kaine questioned Devian's sincere allegiance to Palpatine, while Devian likewise doubted Kaine's honest commitment to the [[High Human Culture/Legends|High Human Culture]] principles of COMPNOR. However, his rabid behavior garnered the approval of party leader [[Crueya Vandron/Legends|Crueya Vandron]] and ultimately the personal notice of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Warlords Part 2" />

===Assassin of the Emperor===
{{Quote|Vader himself selected me for service to Palpatine, but not before he&hellip; shall we say&hellip; narrowed the field of candidates. He gave me this as a "reward" for surviving my audition.|Devian to Kir Kanos|<ref name="ce3.3" />}}
Devian was elevated to elite status and became known in [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] circles as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], working directly under the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="ce3.3" /> He was assigned to Palpatine's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], for "refinement" in deadly duels, usually against [[darksider]]s such as [[Antinnis Tremayne]].<ref name="Warlords Part 2" /> In one duel in the arena known as "[[The Squall/Legends|The Squall]]" he killed his competitors but Devian lost his right eye to the Dark Lord, which he promptly had outfitted with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] replacement. Furthermore, as a "reward" for surviving the process, Vader gave Devian a prominent scar on his left arm.<ref name="ce3.3" /> His last test was surviving alone on [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]] against a hunting party of [[Noghri Death Commando]], a test typically reserved only for Vader's most promising apprentices, such as [[Tao (Sith Apprentice)|Tao]] and [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]]. Afterward, Ennix Devian became the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] personal hitman&mdash;dubbed Palpatine's "[[Kaarenth Impaler]]" after the unyieldingly faithful protectors of the ancient [[Paecian Empire]]. The Emperor deployed Devian to hunt down [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] deserters, defectors to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' prisoners, escapees beyond rehabilitation, and anyone the Emperor perceived as betraying their oath to him. Years prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Devian recruited fellow COMPNOR compatriot [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bernard Vota]] to help set up a secret storehouse on the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[RZ7-6113-23]] in the [[Chopani sector/Legends|Chopani sector]]. Over the years, they rerouted and stashed weapons and ships that had been scheduled for decommission or destruction.<ref name="Warlords Part 2" /> They amassed an army of [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[Rise of the Empire era|era]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|military]] hardware and a fleet of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]].<ref name="ce3.3" /> Devian repaired and maintained them as a failsafe against a potential catastrophe in the Empire.<ref name="Warlords Part 2" />

===Warlord===
{{Quote|I fear for the Republic, for your sister's family&hellip; They are in danger. You must warn them about a man named Devian.|Vima-Da-Boda to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="ce3.1">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 1|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 1]]</ref>}}
When the Emperor and Vader died at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], Devian retreated to his RZ7-6113-23 base on the galactic outskirts. He was surrounded on all sides by traitorous Imperials like [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gaen Drommel]], [[Prince-Admiral/Legends|Prince-Admiral]] [[Delak Krennel]], [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], and his nemesis [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] Ardus Kaine. He began a clandestine crusade, the [[Restored Empire|Kaarenth Dissension]], consisting of fanatical hardliners dedicated to sacred restoration of the True Empire of Palpatine.<ref name="Warlords Part 2" /> 

Devian's first foray into warlordism consisted of a raid against [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]]. He stole two incomplete [[Worldcraft|worldcrafts]] that were being built in Coruscant's orbit. One was intended as a gift to him from the Emperor in recognition of his merciless services, while the other was, to Devian's delight, intended for his nemesis Kaine. The cost of completing both crafts would have proven exorbitant, so Devian rerouted them to opposite ends of the galaxy: one to the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] and the other to the [[Spawn Nebula/Legends|Spawn Nebula]].<ref name="Warlords Part 2" /> 

One of these worldcrafts was mocked up to look like a [[Death Star III|third Death Star]] to trick the Rebels with a sophisticated [[Battle of Death Star III|feint]] at their temporary [[Alliance of Free Planets]] capital on Endor. While the Death Star III was easily destroyed, the diversion allowed Dissension forces to stealthily hijack countless warships from neighboring Alliance [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]. The second worldcraft remained hidden, repurposed into a repair facility and shipyard hub. With the the fall of Grand Moff [[Nigel Nivers]], Zsinj, and other warlords to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Devian collected their castoffs to cultivate another Dissension fleet in the Spawn Nebula.<ref name="Warlords Part 2" /> 

For all his planning and plotting, Devian never anticipated the resurrection of the Emperor. When he heard rumors of an [[Omnipotent Battle Leader]] and saw Imperial factions reuniting, he couldn't believe that the Emperor was reborn, and chose not to. Instead of joining his former master, Devian took advantage of the chaos of the [[Pre–Shadow Hand campaign|Pre-Shadow Hand campaign]]. He aligned himself with his old fanatical comrades from COMPNOR and the ISB. Many of which had already joined his cause after Kaine made the decision to merge their organizations with their despicable competitors, [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. Among these recruits was [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Meres Ulcane]], whom Devian charged with turning the enmity of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Alien/Legends|nonhumans]] against the New Republic.<ref name="Warlords Part 2" /> 

A [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] turncoat named [[Kiara Schmong]] helped the Dissension seize heavy [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|technology]], based on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] ''[[Malevolence/Legends|Malevolence]]'', from the laboratories of the [[Federated Teradoc Union]]. Devian equipped all of his ships with this firepower and turned the ion technology against Imperial and New Republic targets alike. Schmong also helped acquire New Republic [[E-7 E-wing multi-role starfighter|E-wings]], which Devian used to assassinate his nemesis Kaine. Devian tricked Kaine into believing [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Octavian Grant|Grant]] was returning to fight for the [[Pentastar Alignment]]. When his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was lured out into the open above [[Palanhi/Legends|Palanhi]], Devian's E-wings neutralized him. Despite these successes, the Dissension suffered a setback when an infiltration team armed with unstable [[illerium]] [[Mission to the Spawn Nebula|destroyed]] the Spawn Nebula worldcraft, its fleet, and Commander Ulcane.<ref name="Warlords Part 2" />   

=== A vision for the galaxy ===
This attack gave Devian an idea. If he could obtain enough illerium of his own, or some other volatile substance like [[zinethium]] or [[Nergon-14/Legends|Nergon-14]], then he could bring down the New Republic by decimating the capital and its leadership. Devian also pursued and alternative method of destroying the galactic capital. He enlisted a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|darksider]] named [[Durrei]] to help locate [[Kashi Mer talisman|an arcane artifact]] believed to have precipitated the [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] of the [[Kashi system|Kashi system's]] sun millennia prior. When Durrei's usefulness ran its course, Devian betrayed him and his lover [[Arden Lyn]] to his old sparring partner [[High Inquisitor]] Tremayne.<ref name="Warlords Part 2" /> 

Following the formation of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], the remains of the Empire after their defeat at the Battle of Endor in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Devian became disenchanted with the leadership of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] under [[Xandel Carivus]] and [[Carnor Jax]]. Following the council's splintering, [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] took the reigns of the Remnant. Many, including Devian, thought of him as a disgrace to the Imperial name. Devian felt that the Imperials would need to embrace their roots, and proclaimed himself [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Restored Empire]] faction in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="ce3.3" /> After his spy network, which included the dignitary [[Zam Basdor]] of Pellaeon's inner circle,<ref name="ce3.6" /> uncovered plans to sign a peace treaty ending the Galactic Civil War between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the Remnant, Supreme Commander Devian organized a complex plot to destroy both factions. He prepared to mobilize the fleet and army he had amassed on RZ7-6113-23. Under his command, the New Republic frigate [[Endor (Dauntless-class)|''Endor'']] was destroyed by a planetary cannon when it investigated the Chopani sector.<ref name="ce3.1" />
[[File:Restored_Empire_tattoo.png|thumb|right|240px|Devian's influence gained him many followers within the Imperial military.]]
"[[Phase One]]" of Devian's plan was to send a team of assassins to murder the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]] in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on Coruscant, while "Phase Two" of his plan was to hamper New Republic and Imperial Remnant relations even further by sabotaging peace talks by launching a terrorist attack on Coruscant.<ref name="ce3.2" /> In order to motivate his men and prove the legitimacy of his cause, Devian hired the renowned [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to track down the former [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Imperial Royal Guard]], [[Kir Kanos]],<ref name="ce3.1" /> who Devian regarded as a living artifact of the late [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine's ideals.<ref name="ce3.2" /> However; this was only a means to his true goal:<ref name="ce3.6" /> while Devian hired Fett to bring Kir Kanos to the Restored Empire [[RZ7-6113-23 base|headquarters]],<ref name="ce3.3" /> a benefactor, [[Nom Anor]], hired a team of thieves to [[Raid on Nyara|infiltrate]] a [[class-3 toxic weapons dump]] on [[Nyara]] in order to retrieve a chunk of [[zinethium]].<ref name="ce3.2" /> Devian wanted to use this volatile substance to destroy the Imperial Palace on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and eliminate the New Republic government, and he planned on using Kir Kanos to plant the substance; he knew that Kanos would reject his offer of recruitment and immediately turn himself into New Republic captivity in order to save the one person he truly loved, [[Mirith Sinn]].<ref name="ce3.3" />

After Phase One of the plan failed, Devian shrugged off the defeat and set the second phase in motion. Boba Fett successfully retrieved Kanos and brought him to the Restored Empire's headquarters, where Devian presented Kanos with the traditional garb of the Imperial Royal Guard and acquainted him with his ideals over a dinner in his honor.<ref name="ce3.2" /> Kanos viewed Devian as a dishonorable thug, an opinion that was bolstered by Devian's slaying of one of his own men, [[Lonkin]], in order to prove his worth in combat. Devian explained his plot to destroy Coruscant with zinethium to the guardsmen; as expected, Kir Kanos refused to join the hard-liners. Imprisoning him in a room in order to "rethink" his decision before being forced to have him executed, Devian implanted the zinethium in a specially prepared shuttle which he predicted would be Kanos's means of escape. Kanos escaped from his chamber using an improvised explosive from a blaster he pickpocketed from Devian during their conversation; Devian sacrificed some stormtroopers to Kanos in order to maintain the illusion that he was really free. Kir Kanos immediately departed to Coruscant to warn the New Republic.<ref name="ce3.3" />

===Attack on Orinda===
{{Quote|Thrilling to watch a plan come together. Don't you think, General Vota?|Devian, in the wake of his attack on Orinda|<ref name="ce3.5" />}}
[[File:BattleOfOrinda-CEIII5.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Devian's fleet approaches Orinda.]]
The attempted zinethium attack on Coruscant was thwarted by the intervention of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who flew the shuttle into orbit before it exploded. Soon after Kanos's departure, Devian detected a New Republic warship under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lar Ndigo]] entering the system, who was investigating the earlier disappearance of the ''Endor''. As such, Devian was forced to abandon base and have a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] engage the Republic forces. The ship's crew managed to raise their shields before the planetary cannon was fully charged, and were allowed to scramble their forces. The warship managed to land a direct blast on the planetary cannon before it was fully charged for another shot, and ground forces were scrambled to investigate.<ref name="ce3.4">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 4|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 4]]</ref> However, this was all a distraction laid out by Devian and Vota, who successfully evacuated their navy from the system and rigged the base to explode, killing the invading Republic forces.<ref name="ce3.5" />

Meanwhile, a peace summit between the Republic and the Remnant attended by [[Feena D'Asta]], the daughter of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Ragez D'Asta]], Mirith Sinn, and Kir Kanos was raided by Devian's stormtroopers, successfully preventing the signing of the treaty. Feena D'asta was killed in the assault, as were all the attacking stormtroopers by Kanos's hand. Kanos discovered the emblem on the Restored Empire tattooed on the wrists of the attackers; he contacted Republic command on Coruscant to explain Devian's role in the attack. While the Republic decided to investigate Devian's involvement, Admiral Pellaeon, unaware of the Restored Empire's existence, felt the Republic was involved and was obligated to launch a retaliatory attack on Coruscant in order to maintain Baron D'Asta's loyalty to the Imperial cause. This effectively left the Remnant capital [[Orinda/Legends|Orinda]] relatively undefended, allowing Devian to move his fleet in for an [[Battle of Orinda (13 ABY)|attack]].<ref name="ce3.5" />

Devian's attack on Orinda was stalled by the sudden arrival of Pellaeon's fleet, who reversed their course from Coruscant after receiving word of the attack. Devian and his men boarded the admiral's flagship and laid waste to Pellaeon's personal guard, forcing the admiral into a surrender. Devian offered Pellaeon the chance to join the Restored Empire cause by abandoning his plans of peace with the Republic and helping to rebuild a stronger Galactic Empire. Devian revealed Basdor as the traitor within Pellaeon's ranks, who was promptly shot in the forehead by the enraged admiral. Devian ordered his guards to seize Pellaeon, and thanked him for killing Basdor for the sake of tying up loose ends. Pellaeon responded by offering Devian the chance to surrender, a notion which the Supreme Commander laughed off. However, Pellaeon revealed that reinforcements in the form of Baron D'Asta's fleet had arrived and were destroying Devian's fleet as they spoke.<ref name="ce3.6" />

====Death====
[[File:Kanos_kills_Devian.jpg|thumb|180px|Kanos kills Devian.]]
{{Quote|Devian! You've run out of time. Prepare to die.|Kir Kanos prior to his climactic duel with Devian|<ref name="ce3.6" />}}
The Baron arrived on Pellaeon's flagship with Kir Kanos, Mirith Sinn, and a squad of stormtroopers. He revealed that he had three fleets lying in wait behind [[Orinda's moon]], catching Devian's forces off guard. D'Asta acquainted Devian with a [[Feena D'Asta (clone)|clone]] of his late daughter grown during the days of the Imperial Ruling Council; passing her off as the original, he convinced Devian that the "attempt" on his daughter's life had failed, and attempted to force him into a surrender. In the confusion, General Vota attempted to execute Pellaeon before being gunned down himself by Mirith Sinn. A massive firefight subsequently broke out. Devian himself attempted to execute the admiral during the chaos, but was disarmed by Sinn. Attempting to flee in a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]], Devian was confronted by Kanos. Clad in the crimson garbs granted to him by Devian during their initial meeting, Kanos swore death to the wayward Imperial hardliner. Devian ordered a squad of stormtroopers to kill him, as he was only one man, but Kanos easily killed them all with a blaster rifle as they charged him.<ref name="ce3.6" />

Devian realized it would be more honorable to have a personal fight to the death with Kanos, and unsheathed his [[Vibro-lance/Legends|vibro-lance]] for a final battle. Kanos managed to sever Devian's vibro-lance in two, and knocked Devian out with a kick to the face. Recovering before Kanos could land the killing blow, Devian countered by similarly bisecting Kanos's weapon. The two men were both trained in combat by Darth Vader, and Devian claimed he knew all of Kanos's tricks. Devian kicked Kanos in the chest, knocking the wind out of him. Devian used this opportunity to impale Kanos in the left shoulder with his vibro-lance. Believing himself to be the victor, Devian revealed to Kanos that his loyalty to Palpatine was all a ploy to serve his own ambition, and swore Kanos would die with that information. Suddenly, Kanos gathered the strength to sever the blade off of Devian's vibro-lance and impaled him vertically through the heart with his weapon. In his dying breaths, Devian swore that he had beaten Kanos; the royal guardsmen reminded Devian of Darth Vader's rule to never be so sure of yourself until your opponent is dead. With Devian's death, the Restored Empire collapsed, and Devian's vision had all but collapsed.<ref name="ce3.6" /> Devian died without ever realizing his own status as a mere puppet by his benefactor, Nom Anor: Anor was, in reality, an agent of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] who desired to destabilize the galaxy by prolonging the Galactic Civil War for as long as possible.<ref name="ce3.2" /><ref name="vector">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I know who you are ... And where you came from. Correct me if I'm mistaken, but you had a reputation under the Emperor as a hitman. Some would even say a thug. I know your history and your dirty work well. I don't trust you.|Kir Kanos to Devian|<ref name="ce3.3" />}}
Devian was known in Imperial circles as something of a "thug"; working directly under Emperor Palpatine, Devian committed various acts of violence in which he took pleasure. Later in his life, following the merciless slaying of one of his own men in an effort to prove his worth in combat to Kir Kanos, Devian rationalized his act by claiming he would not have killed the man if the man's weapon hadn't touched him; the Emperor taught him to overcome all opposition with overwhelming force.<ref name="ce3.3" />

An ultranationalist,<ref name="Warlords Part 1">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-1|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> he claimed to have an unquestioning loyalty to the late Emperor's ideals, and based his vision of a "Restored Empire" around this mentality. However, he later revealed to Kanos that his loyalty to Palpatine was only fabricated, and he used his connection with Palpatine to advance his own personal ambition.<ref name="ce3.6" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|As I said, I was trained by Vader. There's no trick you can use that I don't know.|Devian to Kir Kanos during their final battle|<ref name="ce3.6" />}}
[[File:Blaster_bomb.jpg|left|thumb|250x250px|Kanos destabilizes Devian's blaster, creating a makeshift [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] to escape.]]
Devian was personally trained by Darth Vader in The Squall as an assassin, and as such was a master of [[Vibro-lance/Legends|vibro-lance]] combat; he considered himself an equal to that of Kir Kanos himself.<ref name="ce3.3" /> As such, during their final battle over Orinda, Devian managed to hold his own against Kanos for a time while showcasing his similar fighting style and knowledge of "tricks" taught to him by Darth Vader; however, Devian would fall to Kanos's blade.<ref name="ce3.6" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ennix Devian made his first and only appearance as the main antagonist in [[Star Wars: Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost|''Star Wars: Crimson Empire III—Empire Lost'']], the third installment of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' ''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire]]'' saga written by [[Mike Richardson]].
